brief: Review the retry bug: can a retry after a timeout book one invoice twice? Recommend one fix and one test.

assign-timeout.body: Trace the timeout path in invoice_export/client.py. Can a retry submit twice?

assign-fixtures.body: Find a fixture in tests/ that makes the first API call time out. Send it to Timeout.

fixtures-finding.body: SlowOnceApi in tests/test_client.py:6 times out once and records every request_id.

timeout-done.body: Yes: client.py:15 makes a new request_id on every attempt. Checked with SlowOnceApi.

fixtures-done.body: Sent SlowOnceApi to Timeout. It reproduces the duplicate.
